name: milpa/framework
description: The composer create-project starting point for a Milpa app: a runtime whose every capability is a declared Operation, reachable from the terminal, from MCP and from a TUI at once. No database, no web framework — an agent-operable substrate you extend with plugins.

suggest.milpa/agent: Sesiones que sobreviven al proceso: plan, pendientes, permisos y `coa chat`
suggest.milpa/ai-gateway: Que el agente CORRA: un modelo al otro lado de `coa agent`
suggest.milpa/auth: Identidad: convierte un Bearer en un actor con scopes
suggest.milpa/data: Persistencia para tokens y entidades, con cuatro backends
suggest.milpa/devtools: Andamiaje y diagnostico: `coa make`, `coa validate`, `coa doctor`
suggest.milpa/mcp-server: Las mismas operaciones expuestas a un cliente MCP externo
